title: Broaden link-draft payload terminology to both dispatch namespaces
description: Correctness review found draft-lichen-link-01 §2 defines Payload solely as a SCHC-compressed IPv6 datagram, but §3.1/main spec also defines dispatch 0x15 for raw LICHEN routing/control bodies alongside dispatch 0x14 SCHC. Update terminology so PLD is the authenticated dispatch octet plus its selected body; do not imply all payloads are SCHC/IPv6.
